name: nestjs-demo-app
description: Monorepo: NestJS backend, Angular frontend and shared data objects – the reference example for a series of one-minute videos

scripts.build: npm run build -w libs/data-objects && npm run build -w apps/nestjs -w apps/frontend
scripts.start:dev: npm run build -w libs/data-objects && concurrently --names data-objects,nestjs,frontend --prefix-colors blue,red,green "npm run build:watch -w libs/data-objects" "npm run start:dev -w apps/nestjs" "npm start -w apps/frontend"
scripts.test: npm run build -w libs/data-objects && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w libs/data-objects && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
